title: Chapter 14 Revision: Conditional Mood
description: Mixed questions covering conditional forms (masc/fem/plural), wishes with chciałbym/wolałbym, gdyby clauses, and conditional vocabulary.

questions.prompt: ___ do Italii, gdybym miał więcej pieniędzy. (I (m) would go to Italy if I had more money.) [pojechać, ja m conditional]
questions.explanation: Masculine conditional ja: pojechałbym (pojechał + bym). 'Pojechałabym' = feminine. 'Pojadę' = future. 'Pojechałem' = past.

questions.prompt: ___ zamówić stolik na dziś wieczór. (I (f) would like to book a table for tonight.) [chcieć, ja f conditional]
questions.explanation: Feminine polite request: chciałabym (chciała + bym). 'Chciałbym' = masculine. Restaurant/service context → conditional is more polite than 'chcę'.

questions.prompt: Gdyby ___ piękna pogoda, poszlibyśmy na piknik. (If the weather were nice, we'd go on a picnic.) [być, ono/ona — gdyby clause]
questions.explanation: Gdyby + past form: 'była' (past of być, f/neuter sing — 'pogoda' is feminine). The entire gdyby clause uses past form. 'Poszlibyśmy' = conditional (we would go).

questions.prompt: ___ pojechał na Mazury. (If I were you, I'd go to the Mazury lakes.) [na twoim miejscu]
questions.explanation: 'Na twoim miejscu' = if I were you / in your place. Followed by conditional: pojechał(bym). A fixed phrase for giving advice.
'Żałować + genitive' = to regret. 'Żałuję, że nie przyszedłem' = I regret not coming / I'm sorry I didn't come.

questions.prompt: ___ zostać w domu niż iść na tę nudną imprezę. (I (m) would prefer to stay home rather than go to that boring party.) [woleć, ja m conditional]
questions.explanation: Masculine preference conditional: wolałbym (wolał + bym). 'Wolałabym' = feminine. 'Wolę' = present (I prefer). 'Wolałem' = past (I preferred).

questions.prompt: What is the difference between 'jeśli przyjdziesz' and 'gdybyś przyszedł'?
questions.explanation: 'Jeśli przyjdziesz' = if you come (real, open condition — you might come). 'Gdybyś przyszedł' = if you were to come (hypothetical — I don't really expect you to).
'Niestety' = unfortunately. 'Niestety nie mogę przyjść' = Unfortunately I can't come. Contrast: 'na szczęście' = fortunately.

questions.prompt: Chciałbym, żeby ___ lepsza pogoda. (I wish the weather were better.) [być — żeby + past]
questions.explanation: 'Chciałbym, żeby + past form': żeby była (f past — pogoda is feminine). The 'żeby + past' pattern expresses a present/future wish.

questions.prompt: They (women only) would go on holiday. [pojechać, one conditional]
questions.explanation: Non-virile plural conditional: pojechałyby (-łyby ending). 'Pojechaliby' = virile plural. 'Pojadą' = future. 'Pojechały' = past.
'Powodzenia!' = Good luck! (literally: of success — genitive). Common on exams, interviews, competitions. 'Dziękuję, będę potrzebować!' = Thanks, I'll need it!

questions.prompt: Complete: 'Gdybym ___ więcej czasu, uczyłbym się więcej.' (If I had more time, I'd study more.) [mieć, ja m]
questions.explanation: Gdyby + past form: 'miał' (past of mieć, m). The 'gdybym' + past tense form makes the hypothetical. 'Gdybym miał' = if I had. 'Uczyłbym się' = conditional (I would study).
